description.value: The Ram's Head Inn is a boutique lodge established in the 1970s, situated in its own private forest within the Red Mountain ski resort just outside Rossland — described on the website as the only boutique lodge in the world with its own forest at a ski resort. It offers a range of rooms and suites decorated by local BC artists, a common lounge with fireplace, wooden hot tub, sauna, and an included breakfast that guests consistently praise as exceptional. The lodge is dog-friendly and well-positioned for cyclists exploring the Kootenay region and the Powder Highway.

address.value: 4465 Red Mountain Rd. Rossland, BC V0G 1Y0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Ram's Head Inn is an operating boutique lodge at 4465 Red Mountain Rd, Rossland, BC, with matching phone and address details. The gallery page lists a photo captioned 'Rams Head Inn – Guest Ski Storage,' suggesting organized guest equipment storage exists, and another captioned 'Rams Head Inn – Mountain Bike in Parking Lot,' showing a mountain bike on-site but not in a clearly secure arrangement — neither caption is explicit enough to confirm secure overnight bike storage. Breakfast is confirmed via multiple guest testimonials ('daily changing breakfast'), but no cyclist-specific amenities (Wi-Fi, laundry, e-bike charging, etc.) are mentioned on the website.
concerns: OSM addr:housenumber field contains only '4465' with no street name; full address '4465 Red Mountain Rd, Rossland, BC V0G 1Y0' is taken from the website.
OSM tags the property as 'motel' but the website consistently describes it as a boutique lodge — not a concern for inclusion but may warrant an OSM tag correction.
Website footer copyright reads '© 2015 - 2023'; the site may not have been updated recently, though there is no indication the business is closed.
Gallery caption 'Rams Head Inn – Mountain Bike in Parking Lot' suggests bikes may be stored outdoors rather than in a secure facility, but evidence is insufficient to confirm or deny.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating boutique lodge in a well-known BC cycling and ski destination. Breakfast included and dog-friendly; worth listing for touring cyclists travelling the Powder Highway corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: A separate gallery photo is captioned 'Rams Head Inn – Guest Ski Storage,' which indicates organized equipment storage exists on-site. It would be worth contacting the inn directly to confirm whether this storage is also available for bicycles and whether it is locked/secure overnight.
